newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sanonda to offer 80 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Sanonda to offer 80 mln B shares.

text.p: Chinese pesticide producer Sanonda Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it aims to launch an offer of 80 million class B shares for foreign investors next year, and subsequently list the equity on the Shenzhen bourse.

Hubei-based Sanonda, which has A shares for domestic investors listed in Shenzhen, is awaiting final approval of the Shenzhen Securities Management Office on the issue of B shares, a company spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin.
He said Sanonda has named Shenzhen J&A Securities the domestic underwriter for the issue, but added that it was still in the process of selecting an international coordinator.
If the B share offer is approved, Sanonda plans to funnel the proceeds into expanding production of pesticides.
It has forecast pre-tax profits of about 100 million yuan for this year, the spokesman said.

At the end of last year, Sanonda had total share capital of 139.97 million shares, comprising 65.18 million state shares, 70.55 million A shares, 4.17 million rights shares transferred from state to public shareholders, and 75,400 staff shares.
